candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business Starbucks Corporation (SBUX) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Starbucks operates and licenses Starbucks coffeehouses. Company-operated stores are the primary model in the United States, with licensed stores more common in some international markets. Principal operations: Starbucks Corporation. Reported segments include: North America (72% of revenue); International (23% of revenue); Channel Development (5% of revenue). As of year end, approximately 48% of system restaurants were franchised and the remainder were company-operated.
